title: Luceras Surface
heading: Luceras: the look (standard finish)
lede: Stage 7 of 11. The coat, pattern, fur, horns, eyes and claws, rendered in the same three.js renderer the game uses on phones, beside your model sheet. Coat colors are measured to match the sheet within a couple of steps; the pattern follows it. The open question is how shaggy the fur should be in the game: the sheet is a painting with fur in every strand; this build carries the fur in the texture plus tufts along the outline. Approve the look, or say what needs work and in which view.
fallback: Approvals cannot be saved from this view; reply in chat.
compositeEmpty: Confirm closes the standard look; next come the four finishes and the lighting style, both yours to pick.
confirmed: Confirmed; finishes and lighting style come next.

fold.title: What the fur costs
fold.text: A phone draws fur three ways: painted into the texture (cheap, what most of the coat is now), see-through tufts along the outline (what the chest, belly, legs and plume have, raised to 15,000 triangles for this), or stacked see-through shells over the whole body (the shaggiest, and the most expensive on phones because every shell is drawn over the last). More shagginess means more tufts or shells; the frame cost is measured on your phone at the export stage either way. Three Codex passes so far: about 3 hours, about 980K Codex tokens.
